name: hide-bitfield-children
title: Hide individual bit-field children
description: Add an optional per-bit-field-child hidden flag (BitFieldChild.hidden) so individual named bits inside a bit-field container can be hidden in the Struct Instances view, revealed by the existing per-profile 'show hidden fields' toggle. Reuses the field-level hidden plumbing; instance-view only (decode/offsets/C preview unchanged).
creator: deviousprophet
